say:3:1230884001:0.text: We've prepared a small dinner and would love for you to join us.
say:3:1230884001:0.source_cn: 我们备下了薄宴，邀请您再度相聚。
say:3:1230884001:0.male: We've prepared a small dinner and would love for you to join us.
say:3:1230884001:0.female: We've prepared a small dinner and would love for you to join us.

say:5:1230884003:0.text: Sit next to me! I want to tell you a secret!
say:5:1230884003:0.source_cn: 老师，坐我旁边！我要跟你说悄悄话！
say:5:1230884003:0.male: Sit next to me! I want to tell you a secret!
say:5:1230884003:0.female: Sit next to me! I want to tell you a secret!

choice_prompt:6:1230884003.text: Sit next to me! I want to tell you a secret!
choice_prompt:6:1230884003.source_cn: 老师，坐我旁边！我要跟你说悄悄话！
choice_prompt:6:1230884003.male: Sit next to me! I want to tell you a secret!
choice_prompt:6:1230884003.female: Sit next to me! I want to tell you a secret!

say:7:1230884004:0.text: You and I have already gained so much from our shared journey. There's no need for a Celestial to guide us here.
say:7:1230884004:0.source_cn: 您和我已在共同的旅程中收获很多，应该无需半神阁下再度指点。
say:7:1230884004:0.male: You and I have already gained so much from our shared journey. There's no need for a Celestial to guide us here.
say:7:1230884004:0.female: You and I have already gained so much from our shared journey. There's no need for a Celestial to guide us here.

say:8:1230884005:0.text: Nevertheless, the brew from Archon Dionel was truly delightful. I wonder if I'll have another chance to enjoy a glass.
say:8:1230884005:0.source_cn: 不过，萨基塔里斯阁下的麦酿是真的很好喝啊。不知道还有没...

say:9:1230884006:1.text: I wish this was one of my dreams. Then, I might've already graduated from the Serene Lyceum.
say:9:1230884006:1.source_cn: 要是一直在梦里就好，我说不定已经从莱西拉姆毕业了。

say:12:1230884007:0.text: Graduated? You should thank Dura you were even accepted...
say:12:1230884007:0.source_cn: 毕业？你能入学都要感谢艾雅了……

say:13:1230884008:0.text: Magister, the bounty hunter is bullying me!
say:13:1230884008:0.source_cn: 呜呜，老师，这个寻宝猎人欺负人！
say:13:1230884008:0.male: Magister, the bounty hunter is bullying me!
say:13:1230884008:0.female: Magister, the bounty hunter is bullying me!

say:14:1230884012:0.text: Indeed. Temesia, isn't it time to begin?
say:14:1230884012:0.source_cn: 咳咳，确实。特弥希娅，是不是该开始了？

say:15:1230884013:1.text: It's nearly time. Everyone, I'm not great with speeches, so I won't deliver a grand toast.
say:15:1230884013:1.source_cn: 时间差不多了。各位，我是一个不善言辞的人，无法说出一些...

say:16:1230884014:0.text: So, let's make it simple. Here's to our reunion.
say:16:1230884014:0.source_cn: 那么，简单一点。为此刻的相聚，共饮一杯吧。

choice:6:0:1.text: Is this another one of Dionel's pranks?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 萨基塔里斯的恶作剧重演了？
choice:6:0:1.male: Is this another one of Dionel's pranks?
choice:6:0:1.female: Is this another one of Dionel's pranks?

say:19:1230884009:0.text: The experiences we've had together have strengthened our friendship, and this lasting connection has led us to gather once more.
say:19:1230884009:0.source_cn: 一同经历过的时光点燃了我们之间的友谊，正是这份永恒的联...

say:22:1230884010:0.text: Someone's words are a bit too serious.
say:22:1230884010:0.source_cn: 哼，某人这话说得也太正经了。

say:23:1230884011:0.text: Hahaha! Temesia's right. Right now, the most important thing is to celebrate!
say:23:1230884011:0.source_cn: 哈哈，特弥希娅说得没错。不过，现在最重要的应该是庆祝！

choice:6:1:2.text: It's great to see you again.
choice:6:1:2.male: It's great to see you again.
choice:6:1:2.female: It's great to see you again.
